fields.why: The Table note 'Data are not presented for cells with sample size <10' is suppression of observed values, which the brief classes as transformation (ancillary); B missed it.

The ≥65 rate is set against the 18–64 and <18 groups as computed ratios (nine and 16 times), so that result is per-group vs referent, not side by side; the side-by-side entry belongs to the 65–74/75–84/≥85 rates, which B recorded separately.
